name: The Cliffspring River
summary: In Darkshore, foul water now runs down the Cliffspring River toward Auberdine. Thundris Windweaver asks Alliance investigators to take a sample from the pool beneath a road bridge waterfall. He suspects the corruption began beyond the riverbanks.

sections.title: A Tainted Waterway
sections.body: The Cliffspring River runs from the eastern highlands to the coastal shoals of Mist's Edge, just north of Auberdine. Its waters have begun to carry an unnatural rot toward the night elf settlement. Thundris Windweaver fears the foul water will poison the shores and the town's supplies, so he sends scouts upriver to take samples from the waterfall pool beneath the road bridge.

sections.title: The Root in Felwood
sections.body: The Blackwood furbolgs have made camps along the river, and their agitation is plain. Thundris suspects they may be spreading the taint, but believes its true root lies elsewhere, in Felwood. He expects the water sample to confirm his suspicion. The forest to the east was scarred during the Third War. To cleanse the water, the corrupted furbolgs must be confronted and the land's ancient sources purified.

faq.q: Where do I collect the water sample?
faq.answer: From Auberdine, head north to the Cliffspring River's mouth at Mist's Edge. Follow the river inland to the first waterfall, beneath an overhead road bridge, and fill the sampling tube from the pool.

faq.q: Why is the Cliffspring River turning foul?
faq.answer: Thundris suspects the Blackwood furbolgs along the river may be spreading the foulness, though he believes their corruption has a deeper root. He needs a water sample to investigate.
Thundris Windweaver is a night elf scholar and investigator in Auberdine. He studies Darkshore's spreading ecological decay and seeks the causes of regional corruption.

faq.q: Are the furbolgs responsible for poisoning the river?
faq.answer: Thundris suspects the Blackwood furbolgs may be spreading the taint, but believes their corruption has a deeper source. The water sample will help him investigate.

faq.q: How does this river impact Auberdine?
aliases: why does auberdine care about cliffspring
faq.answer: The Cliffspring River flows into Mist's Edge just north of Auberdine. Coastal currents may carry the foul runoff to the town's shoreline, threatening its fisheries, flora, and freshwater supply.

faq.q: What happens after testing the sample?
faq.answer: Thundris thanks you for the sample and prepares to investigate the corrupted Blackwood furbolgs further. He hopes to find a way to cleanse their taint.

angles.text: As a druid of the Cenarion Circle, you see clean woodland waters turned foul by lingering demonic taint and are called to cleanse Darkshore's wounded nature.
As a night elf, you know Auberdine depends on Darkshore's coastline. If the spreading rot reaches Mist's Edge, it threatens Kaldorei homes and livelihoods.
